name: What is the process for filing a quadriplegia injury lawsuit?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for filing a quadriplegia injury lawsuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with an investigation and evidence gathering, followed by filing a formal complaint in court. After this, both sides exchange information through discovery. Many cases are resolved through negotiation, mediation, or settlement conferences before trial. If a settlement cannot be reached, the case proceeds to trial. Your lawyer will guide you through each stage, advocating on your behalf.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves investigation, filing a complaint, discovery, negotiations, and potentially a trial if no settlement is reached.
